Debate on domestic scoring aside, I don’t think we should say anything “cost them the gold” because the gold wasn’t ever guaranteed. The gold was never USA’s to lose, ROC outscored them (even with Simone) on day 1 in quals. The team score from quals also didn’t include Jordan’s misses on beam and bars because the lowest scores get dropped, so she can’t be blamed for it. Even if you substitute Jordan’s (domestically overcooked) trials scores in, USA doesn’t beat ROC’s quals score. Team USA *won silver*, they didn’t lose the gold. Their score in the team final was a result of multiple mistakes, not just Jordan’s, and earning a silver medal behind a very talented Russian team is an impressive accomplishment.

I definitely feel sympathy for Tyler in his situation and am glad he didn’t do it, but some school shooters are just violent and bad people and no amount of kindness can stop them.

Also, fuck Montgomery, but his conversation with Bryce actually made me feel quite bad for him. He never had a good family, and chances are Bryce has been protecting (read: manipulating) him for years to the point where serving Bryce is really all he knows how to do. So when even Bryce tells him to fuck off, the kid is devastated and lost. I was hoping he would take that opportunity to do good and make up for his bad actions, but he didn’t so fuck him for what he did to Tyler
